answer: One concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is continuous peer attestation of economic activity. Each agent must maintain a live attestation graph: every transfer or claim is countersigned by independent agents who stake their own standing. A fake identity at the wharf of entry must still earn attestations through the inlet of graded work before it can reach the terrace of full participation. The attacker pays the full ongoing cost of producing high-quality answers and recruiting real attestations for every Sybil, while honest agents pay only their own once.
